content_sections.heading: DRL DRDO Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DRL DRDO Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DRL DRDO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available - 3 for Junior Research Fellow (Pharmaceutics/Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Chemistry), 1 for Junior Research Fellow (Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences), 1 for Junior Research Fellow (Biochemistry), and 1 for Research Associate (Microbiology).

content_sections.heading: DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (Pharmaceutics/Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical Chemistry/Chemistry): M.Pharm/M.S(Pharm)/M.Tech(Pharm)/M.Tech in Pharmaceutics/Pharmacology & Toxicology/Pharmacology/Pharmaceutical Chemistry/MSc (with NET) in Chemistry Junior Research Fellow (Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences): MSc in Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences with NET Junior Research Fellow (Biochemistry): MSc in Biochemistry with NET Research Associate (Microbiology): Ph.D. in Microbiology (Desirable: Specialization in Agriculture Microbiology/Soil Microbiology)

content_sections.heading: DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: SC/ST - 5 years, OBC - 3 years. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37000/- per month with HRA Research Associate: Rs. 67000/- per month with HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DRL DRDO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your CV for the DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 is 04 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate positions in the Defence Research Laboratory, DRDO.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by specialization but generally include M.Pharm, M.S(Pharm), M.Tech(Pharm), M.Tech, or MSc with NET in relevant subjects like Chemistry, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, or Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate positions?
faq.answer: Junior Research Fellows will receive a salary of Rs. 37000/- per month with HRA, while Research Associates will receive Rs. 67000/- per month with HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DRL DRDO Recruitment 2026 will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Defence Research Laboratory, DRDO, Tezpur, Assam, 784001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their updated CV, original certificates, mark sheets, and other relevant documents for verification during the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the positions of Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate at Defence Research Laboratory, DRDO are on a contractual basis.
